limitations: Only the B-sequence part of the two-sequence conjecture is established; Q remains untreated.
The exact measure is parametrically represented; no simple closed radical expression in the push-forward coordinate is required.
Possible unindexed equivalent prior work cannot be ruled out by searches alone.

scientific_integrity.basis: The binomial enumeration and ternary-tree generating function are attributed to their published sources. The positive measure, its exact density and all-order strict Hankel-minor consequences are the new result.
scientific_integrity.independent_validation: No independent external scientific validation or independent audit is represented.
scientific_integrity.verification: Mathematical proof by analytic continuation, Stieltjes inversion, and generalized Vandermonde positivity; symbolic and high-precision finite checks are supplementary only.
